dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature along the trailing edge, forming a smooth falcate spline from the posterior insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse morphological profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-50 degree incline relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum pixel base width to the maximum vertical height is approximately 1.45:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large-radius convex arc extending from the blowhole region to the anterior tip, creating a blunt profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely short rostrum with minimal horizontal projection beyond the anterior curve of the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow interior angle at the transition point between the melon and the short rostrum terminus.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular and oval-shaped depigmented lesions are visible on the mid-flank; fine linear scarring is present on the lateral body wall.
other_distinctive_markers: Blunt, rounded head morphology lacking a distinct elongated beak; distinctive light-colored ventral-lateral patch.
